pr.title: feat(composition): qualify the SDK 4.1 and Tenants 7.0.2 tuple
pr.body:
Package CI using the newer SDK 4.1.0/Tenants 7.0.2 catalog cannot compose the signed AppHost handoff: validation projects away the claim directory, while the existing proof compares against the complete saved plan and reader qualification recognizes the older tuple. Bind genuine published Builds 4.44.3/fc212, admit only the authentic validation-only one-field projection, and add closed public-body authorities for the selected SDK/Tenants pair. Ordinary claim/source/key binding, historical authorities and all refusal gates remain intact.

Keep the private reader on the selected SDK Server version, handle typed binary-refusal results in its boolean predicates, and cover the complete public owner closure. Preserve all four historical catalog CI lanes and add the exact current pair.

Validation: clean committed-head Release/package build passed with zero warnings/errors; all 342 required cases passed with zero failures, errors, skips or unrun cases, including 22 actual signed-AppHost handoff cases and 47 public-body controls. Source and all 161 output DLLs were unchanged. Independent audit rehashed 2,868 retained files and all 317 prepared signed-tool members; SDK capability, public reader and tuple controls passed. First failures remain retained.

Hosted exact-source tuple and five-SDK catalog gates follow this proposal. Source/component checks grant no native, candidate or whole-story acceptance; current EventStore/Parties adoption and actual lifecycle qualification follow normal Platform publication.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **High Risk**
> Changes core composition admission, signed public-artifact verification, and run-plan proof binding for package mode and published AppHost validation—security- and release-critical paths where regressions could admit wrong bytes or weaken handoff checks.
> 
> **Overview**
> This PR **promotes the Platform tuple to Builds `4.44.3`** and makes **EventStore `4.1.0` with Tenants `7.0.2`** a first-class package-catalog cohort alongside the historical `4.0.4`/`7.0.0` authorities.
> 
> **Closed public-reader cohorts** gain new identifiers and SHA-256 tables for the current SDK/Tenants pair; admission, routing-catalog generation, and Parties full-profile binding now **select cohort from declared versions** (mixed pairs still refuse) and pin **Tenants `7.0.2` image manifests**. Predicate helpers treat typed byte mismatches as false without weakening strict verification.
> 
> **Signed AppHost `--validate-platform` handoff** is fixed: validation may project only a nonempty absolute `ResourceClaimStateDirectory` to null when the genuine published AppHost/tooling bytes and environment match; ordinary runs still require the full persisted plan. Parties run proof accepts that single-field projection; new handoff and cohort tests expand CI to **342** cases, including a **`4.1.0` catalog-builder matrix lane** and **`verify_public_owner_cohorts.py`**.
> 
> Provenance and docs move default qualification pins to **`4.1.0`/`7.0.2`**; catalog builder package mode also references **`Hexalith.EventStore.Server`** for the selected SDK.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit b0e37b68b50023df50f1b7bbcb8361d3766f6354. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
